estimate.source: Google Cloud public list prices retrieved 2026-09-19
notes: Memorystore for Redis Basic M1 is $0.049 per GiB-hour. One GiB for 730 hours is about $35.77 before regional multipliers, backups, or egress.
Cloud SQL and Cloud Run are additional. This floor already consumes most of the $50 cap.
Region latency and Asia list-price deltas are not measured in this task.

lineItemsUsd.service: Cloud SQL PostgreSQL shared-core plus 10 GB disk (non-HA, US-list proxy)
lineItemsUsd.basis: Public calculator-class shared-core instances are commonly about 10 USD/month in us-central1; Asia regions may cost more. Used as a lower bound, not a quote.

lineItemsUsd.service: Cloud Run API plus realtime (min instances 0)
lineItemsUsd.basis: Request/CPU/memory pricing; not a substitute for a production-equivalent load run.
